summary: Iteration 33: Tested Working Paper (WP) metrics in Activity Score feature. Fixed critical bug in teacher-full-review endpoint where wp_docs and wp_audit were not being passed to compute_activity_scores(). All backend and frontend tests PASSED after fix.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/monitoring/teacher-full-review/{teacher_id} returns activity_metrics.breakdown with 9 metrics (including wp_documents and wp_actions)
Backend: GET /api/monitoring/teacher-full-review/{teacher_id} returns daily_metrics.breakdown with 8 metrics (including wp_documents and wp_actions)
Backend: wp_documents monthly has weight=15, count_30d, total fields
Backend: wp_documents daily has weight=20, count_today, target=2 fields
Backend: wp_actions monthly has weight=10, count_30d, total fields
Backend: wp_actions daily has weight=15, count_today, target=5 fields
Backend: GET /api/monitoring/my-review returns WP metrics in both monthly and daily breakdowns
Frontend SuperAdmin: Daily Score tab shows 8 metric cards including 'Working Paper Docs' and 'Working Paper Actions'
Frontend SuperAdmin: Monthly Score tab shows 9 metric cards including 'Working Paper Docs' and 'Working Paper Actions'
Frontend Teacher: Daily Score tab shows 8 metric cards including WP metrics with correct weights (20%, 15%)
Frontend Teacher: Monthly Score tab shows 9 metric cards including WP metrics with correct weights (15%, 10%)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: teacher-full-review endpoint was missing wp_docs and wp_audit parameters in compute_activity_scores() call (line 755-757)
my-review endpoint correctly passes wp_docs and wp_audit to compute_activity_scores()
Monthly weights correctly sum to 100: lessons=15, assignments=12, plans=10, files=8, clock_hours=15, grading=8, platform_activity=7, wp_documents=15, wp_actions=10
Daily weights correctly sum to 100: lessons=15, assignments=12, plans=8, files=8, clock_hours=15, platform_activity=7, wp_documents=20, wp_actions=15
Frontend correctly displays WP metrics with FolderOpen and Shield icons from lucide-react
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/monitoring.py (fixed compute_activity_scores call to include wp_docs, wp_audit)
